name: designer_image_briefs_v1
description: 6 crisp, logo-level visual design briefs for a real steer->refine image-prompt run. Each is a single tight ask ('give me a creative X; three-sentence visual description for an image-gen prompt'). motif_excludes ban the obvious clichés; archetype_seeds are 8 orthogonal lenses rotated across the samples so the SET doesn't mode-collapse (the same anti-collapse device as the canonical logo brief). Spans packaging / product / editorial / identity / art-direction / spatial.

prompts.brief: Give me a creative bottle-and-packaging design for a niche luxury perfume. I want a three-sentence visual description suitable for an image-generation prompt.
archetype_seeds: geology — mineral crystal, eroded stone, sediment layers
marine biology — shell spiral, deep-sea bioluminescence, coral branching
apothecary — measured glassware, vials, lab instruments
confectionery — wax seal, blown sugar, hard candy
machined hardware — milled billet, fastener, hinge
